notes.title: Major Update to FlightLevel : Voice recognition and much more
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! It's been a while since our last update, but the team has been hard at work fixing bugs, enhancing stability, and even adding exciting new features. We're thrilled to announce that the latest build is finally ready for release into the public build for all to enjoy.

The most significant addition is the voice recognition feature, which is functioning smoothly enough that we would like more people to play with it to gather feedback for further improvements. We’ve also created a short video introducing this new feature, along with an overview of Flightlevel in general.
You can find the video here:
Introduction to FlightLevel Voice recognition feature.

In addition to the major feature update, we've introduced endless multiplayer mode, giving you the ability to play without limits. There’s also a brand-new in-game settings menu, and we’ve completely revamped the wind trajectory calculations to improve accuracy.

These are just a few highlights of this substantial update. You can find the full list of changes below.
MAIN Alpha 0.8.13.09 - Win, Mac
Added: Speech recognition model
Added: Logic to translate detected words into the internal clearance format
Added: Settings menu option to toggle control mode between using voice and clicking in label
Added: Option to select Left or Right turn when giving a heading or direct routing
Added: More voice lines to Tutorial
Added: Speech recognition introduction video
Added: Frequency for next unit displayed in label when transferring
Added: Dummy logic for handling electronic coordination rate requests
Added: Trajectory computer wind effect
Added: Top of descent refactor and wind effect
Added: In scenario editor, right-click on flight to see wind effect vectors (in knots)
Added: Settings panel in main menu
Added: Settings panel in game, on the pause menu
Added: Settings for display 
Added: Game master volume setting
Added: Ability to mute ATC
Added: Setting for separate UI and Label scaling
Added: Setting to select color scheme
Changed: Label lines now attach to label corners to not interfere with the label information
Changed: UI scaling no longer focuses on FHD
Adjusted: Rate of descent in arrival phase
Changed: Custom color schemes are still searched by the game in FlightLevel_Data, but now all files that contain “uisettings” and have the “.cfg” extension are parsed, so e.g. “amazing_uisettings.cfg” would be loaded as well
Changed: how scene changes work - that should alleviate some of the problems that arise when reloading scenes in game
Changed: Made tutorial texts bigger
Changed: Ui layout adjustment in popups to cohere with established design practices
Changed: Various smaller UI tweaks
Changed: Increased camera maximum zoom
Changed: FMC takes remaining track miles into consideration for rate of descent in the arrival phase
Changed: A lot of testing and tweaking of the descent rate and speed in the approach phase - traffic stayed a bit high and fast for intercepting ILS (more work to be done)
Fixed: A bug where the next unit would transfer flights back for no reason when using voice for control
Fixed: Frequency readback omitted a zero “0” if after decimal the first character was such
Fixed: Fix names defaulted to on
Fixed: Rate requests for incoming flights from the label now show the proper popup
Fixed: Endless mode time setting in menu was ignored and scene started at 0730
Fixed: Sector Dummy did not consider some flights Assumed that started in no sector but were on frequency
Fixed: Background image scaling
Fixed: Main menu multiplayer panel in endless mode did not show endless set info
Fixed: MP should load again, the problem was with accidental scene mapping change in LevelManager
Fixed: One bug related to reloading campaign scenarios where wrong campaigns were selected and everything got messed up
Fixed: Dummies got confused when re-entering a game scene due to a time parameter not being reset. That parameter influences when a Dummy looks at incoming OLDI requests etc.
Fixed: The adjacent sector approach Dummy clears flights to ILS intercept altitude
Fixed: ILS runway selection for clearance by Dummy chose wrong runways - now selects based on FAF
Fixed: Dummy had problems understanding when it is ok to give clearances
Changed: A lot of testing and tweaking of the descent rate and speed in the approach phase - traffic stayed a bit high and fast for intercepting ILS (more work to be done)
Fixed: “Stand by” confused pilots
Fixed: On Mac tracks not displayed
Fixed: On Mac label popup panel had no background
Fixed: On Mac the N key did not display fix names

notes.title: ENDLESS MODE is here. Big update for Flightlevel.
notes.notes:
So here we are. We are proud to announce that one of the biggest features requested by our fans is finally in the public testing phase. 
Endless mode gives you the opportunity to play flightlevel with randomized traffic as long as you want. Its currently availiable for Estonian airspace but more airspaces are coming. 
We are currently implementing endless mode to multiplayer aswell.

full changelog below:

Added: Label UI scaling (adjustable at the moment by O and P keys) is now a persistent setting

notes.title: We are back. Summer has been awesome.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

I hope you are having a great summer. Towerhouse team is back from the holiday and we are already pushing out the first big update and bugfix patch. 

So big things first. We have added an “Atcopedia”. It is an in-game information environment for all your ATCO needs. For now there's only basic articles but the plan is to extend it with more entries as time goes on.

We also found a performance issue and that has now been fixed as well. Thanks to everyone who found it and pointed it out. Lot of bugs regarding the UI modding feature have been fixed.

On other news. Weather is working but it is a bit “wonky” - Pilots are still getting the hang of things =). We will take a closer look at that problem next. 

What's next? - We still have some bugs to squish and some easy features implemented but after that the next big thing is the “next sector dummy”. We need to improve the intelligence of the neighboring sectors to give our user the closest possible experience of working in a teamwork based environment.

Till next time
Team Towerhouse.

notes.title: One big update before the Summer holidays
notes.notes:
Another day, another update.
As the month of june draws to conclusion we at Towerhouse are ready to push out our final build before the summer holiday. And it is a good one. There are 2 big updates and a lot of smaller bug fixes. Big thanks to everyone who has been reporting bugs. 

So what do we have for you today?

Weather is here - You can now make scenarios with weather events like CBs and weird/extreme wind conditions. Pilots are still going through a bit of training on how to handle those events but weather itself works fine. Your feedback is greatly appreciated when it comes to weather testing. Join as at discord for bug testing and other conversations.
https://lnkd.in/ezaym49r

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140815/ae49209184eb837bdc46221d395877f3021a0dd6.png[/img]

Another big thing is the possibility to modify the UI colors. Up to 50 different parameters can be changed to make your radar screen look just the way you like. Example of a darker themed color scheme is displayed in the picture above.
Tutorial on how to modify the UI can be found in the discord channel. Under the #modding-discussion thread.
https://lnkd.in/ezaym49r

Game is still available in Early access on Steam

notes.title: FlightLevel developer update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. Greetings from Team Towerhouse. How have you been? We are doing great. All of us had our first real vacation since the development began and feeling refreshed. Our coding team is busy implementing the weather and we will push the early weather functionality to dev build soon. Until then here's a sneak peak of “work in progress”.

We also had a meeting regarding the future of the game and the current roadmap. We are going to do some tweaks according to the input you guys give us. notes.title: Second bugfix patch 29.03.2023

Team has been busy fixing a lot of bugs found by our testers, players and supporters. Thank you all for your input.

You can now add your own voice to the game.
Full list of updates as follows: 

MAIN Alpha 0.4.28.03
Added(untested): DDMMSSSS / DDDMMSSSS handling. Which means that the last two SS are the decimals. The parsing method checks for string length, so the user can either add or omit the second decimals
Added: Small indication to aircraft to indicate if it is transmitting to simulate the fact that controllers distinguish pilots by voice
Added: Loading sound files from Voices folder
Added: Ragnar’s voice for demonstration of folders and clips
Added: Scenario Departures for all and Puzzle 3
Fixed: If callsign was four characters long e.g. CCA9, the number audio was not played
Fixed: Pilots did not register being identified properly, when departing
Fixed: Some scrolling issues in the main menu
Fixed: Ragnar swearing on the frequency
Fixed: Coordinate parsing and projection logic - runways are quite parallel now
Fixed: In the main menu the tutorials button was not reacting on first click
Fixed: Loading screen
Fixed: Performance issue from scenario starting monitor
Fixed: DCT list scrolling
Fixed: In Editor, list for setting playable sectors did not resize properly based on available sector count
Changed: lowered transmission duration for inaudible tx, should make transfers from bot faster
Changed: Reduced pilot reaction time for operating the aircraft radio for frequency switching

Some of those fixes were already implemented in our DEV build. You can find it on steam and everybody should have access to it. Just pay attention which version of the build you are playing when making bugreports. If you don't, we presume that you are talking about the latest public build.

Updates incoming:
Steam workshop integration
Campaign voiceover

Community Day

Stay tuned for the more precise schedule of the event.

notes.title: FlightLevel released in Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140815/fd8d8425f7593845b6d6933c38e03d06d65a04f9.png[/img]

We released the game today to Early Access! 

It has been quite the journey to get to this point - the last few months have been quite hectic with squashing game breaking bugs and trying to get core gameplay working.

I'm not saying the game is perfect, yet, but we are at a point where more feedback is really needed and hence, Early access makes sense.

What did we do in the last few months?
- We enhanced the visuals a bit, since the game looked like it had been designed by a programmer
- Fixed a lot of UI bugs and inconsistencies, although some remain
- Fixed literally over a hundred bugs
- Tuned the electronic coordination and debugged multiplayer a lot
- Added content

And what do we have planned next?
- First, gather feedback and work on critical issues and debug
- Look into getting some API access to enable getting new airspace info into the game
- More modding support and hopefully Steam Workshop support
- Creating content

We will do some planning in the coming days and revise our rough roadmap based on feedback. It appears that modding support is important, but let's see.

We aim to do monthly builds for the main Steam branch, but there is an open dev branch as well for the brave ones.

All in all, we hope that you already enjoy the game as it is. Thank you for your support! And if you spot a bug, please create a ticket in Discord :)

https://discord.gg/Fm3e5ExSES
